name: voiceforge-client
description: VoiceForge desktop client for Windows and Linux

scripts.prepack:desktop: node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(!fs.existsSync('desktop/main.cjs')){throw new Error('Missing Electron entrypoint: desktop/main.cjs')}"
scripts.build:windows: npm run build:ui && npm run prepack:desktop && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:windows:portable: npm run build:ui && npm run prepack:desktop && electron-builder --win portable --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:linux: npm run build:ui && npm run prepack:desktop && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:linux:appimage: npm run build:ui && npm run prepack:desktop && electron-builder --linux AppImage --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:linux:deb: npm run build:ui && npm run prepack:desktop && electron-builder --linux deb --x64 --publish never

linux.synopsis: Self-hosted voice, text and screen sharing client

entry.Name: VoiceForge
entry.Comment: Self-hosted voice, text and screen sharing client
